title: LinkPeer 1.3.1 Available
message: This update introduces auto-detected HTTP/HTTPS link identifiers in post descriptions, a brand-new Notice Board section, faculty credentials, and enhanced app stability.
features: Automatic HTTP/HTTPS & www link detection with direct external browser launching in post descriptions
New Notice Board section for official campus announcements, notices, image & PDF attachment viewers
Faculty credentials (Designation & Department) on profile header
Preselected branch, stream, department & year choices in Edit Profile
App-themed instant bottom-sheet selectors replacing slow dropdown popups
Automatic mark-all-notifications-as-read when visiting Notification Screen
Web version links (linkpeer.swynx.dev) integrated across the app
Production Google AdMob policy compliance & native surface crash fixes
